nodes.text: Mara looks up from a map pinned flat with knives. "Make it quick."

choices.text: These ash drifts are fresh. The Horde is close.
The steel is here. Where does it go?
It's over. The Horde is scattered.

nodes.text: "Warden Keep. One fire, four walls and too few of us to hold either."
"Sharp eyes. Take this; you will need it before I do."
"It is. For now. Drink to it later."
Mara weighs a bar of slag-steel. "Enough for one thing done well. The gate, or your hands?"
"Then the gorge is shut behind you. Whatever waits in the wastes waits alone."
"Then go out sharp. Hest has the rest on his counter."
"One fire lit, and a door that holds. The Long Dry is over. This year."
"The wastes will remember that steel. Rest; you have earned the hearth."
